clips.title: The story
paras: At a roadside post in southeastern Tirisfal, Deathguard Linnea watches the roads between Brill and the eastern borders. Her unit guards against the Scarlet Crusade and the lingering Scourge, with passing travelers sometimes helping on patrol.

Deathguard Linnea guards a fortified post southeast of Brill. The Forsaken defend their young realm against Scarlet Crusade infiltrators and Scourge still prowling the wilderness. Linnea and her fellow guards patrol the road and coordinate reports with Magistrate Sevren in Brill. Their watch keeps the eastern road toward the Bulwark secure.
